extra.final_summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe 37.25, Dream 37.47, Torgersen 39.21 (24 Adelie rows used).

Data issues found and fixed:
- Island label misspellings: "Dram" → "Dream" and "Torgerson" → "Torgersen" (3 rows) merged into the allowed labels per the rules file.
- 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 9 and 22) removed so each penguin is counted once.

Other notes: bill_length_mm values were all within the rules-file range (30–60 mm) with no missing values, so no further fixes were needed. Columns not used by the question (e.g. body_mass_g stored as text, sex case variants) were left untouched.
